Box.description:
One box in pixels of the upright (rotated) image.

source="model":   a raw YOLO detection; cls_id is the model's class index.
source="derived": produced by a PPE rule (e.g. "no-safety-glasses" on a face's eye band);
                  cls_id is null and conf is the confidence of the subject it was derived from.
Box.title: Box

Delivery.description: Set by the hub on receipt. Backfilled records never update current status.
Delivery.title: Delivery

DetectionEvent.description:
C2 — YOLO result for one source frame, tagged with the pose matched by timestamp.

Consumers MUST check pose_valid before using pose; an invalid event may still carry the
nearest pose for debugging. Boxes only: hazard decisions belong to the alerts/safety branch.
DetectionEvent.title: DetectionEvent

EdgeStatus.description: Writer fields are null when no vision.server run is publishing (unknown, not zero).
EdgeStatus.title: EdgeStatus

EvidenceBody.description: Metadata of one clean upright full-resolution JPEG blob, tied to its exact source frame.
EvidenceBody.title: EvidenceBody

FeedAge.description: Rover-clock age of the newest item; null with a reason when there has been none.
FeedAge.title: FeedAge

FrameAssessment.description: One frame under the inspection's bound profile revision (§4).
FrameAssessment.title: FrameAssessment

GapBody.description: Records first_seq..last_seq of `lane` were removed on the rover before the hub had them.
GapBody.title: GapBody

Hazard.description:
The three hazard categories (+ walkway). person_in_path and walkway have no producer yet:
their incidents exist only as SAMPLE data until a producer and its own policy exist.
Hazard.title: Hazard

IncidentBody.description: One append-only state transition (§8.3). Records are never edited.
IncidentBody.title: IncidentBody

IncidentLocation.description: Camera pose of the frame ("observed from here"), never the person's position.
IncidentLocation.title: IncidentLocation
